args.body: Use the existing WELFARE-LIVE-DEMAND mission for the November 20 checkpoint. Reuse the launch baseline and any existing checkpoint work. At the recorded window end, use the then-current permitted aggregate and operator evidence to record a continue/change/stop decision under a valid lease. Separate verified public availability, eligible requests, completed replies, administrative orders and settled receipts. Where classification coverage is incomplete, requests remain UNKNOWN. Before the window ends, advance only an eligible case evidenced through the separate authorized private cycle. Use the existing CAD 49 handoff if applicable and leave order acceptance and settlement attestation to the authorized administrator. Preserve the December 4 17:00 UTC retirement and the host's independent publication gate.

description: Prioritize the existing CAD 49 welfare follow-on. Its payment instructions are configured, while the order register is unavailable in this view and Treasury shows CAD 0 verified revenue and CAD 0 available funding. The latest mail cycle skipped ten items and five feedback sources remain unclassified, so eligible demand is unknown. Retrieve the committed rehearsal evidence and prepare the November 20 decision from permitted aggregates. A verified eligible request would trigger the existing private fulfillment and administrative order handoff. Classified coverage would change what the experiment can conclude.
